classifications.name: Restricted Controlled Unclassified Information & PII
classifications.description: Critical federal contract data, unclassified defense info, and executive financial ledgers governed by NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2.
handling_requirements: FIPS 140-3 KMS encryption at rest and in transit
Strict boundary segmentation without direct perimeter connectivity

classifications.name: Payment Card Industry (PCI-DSS) Enclave Data
classifications.description: Primary account numbers (PAN), CVVs, and magnetic stripe data governed by PCI-DSS v4.0.
handling_requirements: Mandatory cryptographic tokenization before cross-zone egress
Zero inbound access from untrusted zones

classifications.name: Confidential Customer & Employee PII
classifications.description: Customer bank accounts, social security numbers, employee salary histories, and HR records.
handling_requirements: Role-based access control with least-privilege scoping

classifications.name: Internal Operational & Infrastructure Telemetry
classifications.description: Application debug logs, non-sensitive telemetry, system metrics, and test datasets.

classifications.name: Public Marketing & Documentation
classifications.description: Public documentation, marketing images, and public web assets.
